name: Wavinai Search
author: Sirvelia

sections.description:
Enhance your WooCommerce store with Wavinai Search, the smart and customizable
search solution that transforms the way your customers shop.

Unlike standard WooCommerce search, Wavinai delivers instant, relevant, and accurate
results, helping users find what they want faster — and boosting your store’s conversions.

Powered by token-based search algorithms, this plugin ensures lightning-fast
performance and precise matching, even with long or complex queries. The sleek and fully
customizable interface allows you to adapt colors, logos, and styles to perfectly match your brand identity, creating a consistent and engaging user experience across your site.

Whether you run a store in fashion, beauty, electronics, or any other sector, Wavinai
Search adapts effortlessly to your business needs. It’s not only fast and intuitive, but also a free alternative to premium search tools like Doofinder — without the extra costs.

Upgrade your ecommerce today and give your customers the smooth shopping experience
they deserve.

✨ Key Features

✅ Smart product search: Find any product in your store by searching title, description,
content, or SKU.

✅ Dynamic and mobile filters: Provide easy-to-use filters on mobile devices, allowing
customers to refine their search effortlessly.

✅ Filter by taxonomies and attributes: Include categories, tags, and attributes within
search results.

✅ High-precision token-based algorithm: Delivers relevant and fast results, even for long or complex queries.

✅ Rich results: Each product in the search results list displays an image and price to make purchasing decisions easier.

✅ Full customization: Adjust colors, logo, and search interface styles to match your brand identity.

✅ Ultra-fast speed: Instant results as the user types

✅ Universal compatibility: Works with shortcodes and is compatible with all page builders and themes (Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Gutenberg, Avada, Bricks, Oxygen, etc.).

📊 Wavinai Admin Dashboard

  • Real-time analytics: Track user search trends and behavior directly from your
    dashboard.

  • Optimized reindexing: Update your product index with one click for improved
    search performance.

  • Visual customization: Configure columns, logo, and colors to ensure consistency
    with your store’s branding.

🚀 Key Benefits

⭐ Increase your conversion rate with a faster, more efficient shopping experience.

⭐ Reduce bounce rates by delivering highly relevant results instantly.

⭐ Improve customer satisfaction with personalized searches and easy-to-use filters.

⭐ Strengthen your brand by offering a search interface perfectly aligned with your visual identity.
